description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractAppHandle' that implements the 'SparkAppHandle' interface. It manages the lifecycle and state of a Spark application handle, including connection management, event notification, and state transitions within the Spark launcher component.

classes.name: AbstractAppHandle
classes.description: An abstract class managing Spark application handle lifecycle, state, and event notifications within the Spark launcher.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to receive app handle events.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the application handle.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the Spark application via the connection.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the connection and disposes of the handle.

methods.name: isDisposed
methods.description: Checks if the handle is disposed.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Marks the handle as disposed and sets state to LOST if not final.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the application state, with optional force.

methods.name: setAppId
methods.description: Sets the application ID and fires an event.

methods.name: fireEvent
methods.description: Fires state or info change events to listeners.
